$schema_note: Hand-verified game knowledge, NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file. global.eSt is refilled at every Room Start by five-argument ReturnSpecificStat calls, one per slot, carrying the slot's stat id. A mechanic runs only if eSt[0] <= 0 AND each of its own slots is > 0 (the comparison directions are a static reading; the values are measured). The values are real parameters, not divisors: setting Battlefield's or Rift's slot to 1 stopped the mechanic. `measured_value` is one character's reading on 2026-08-25, not a constant. Markers are named, never indexed: the S10 notes' object indices belong to an older build, so resolve them through hs-game-sdk. Prose and sources: docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md section 14.
source: ForgePact/docs/S10-special-content-notes.md, sections on eSt being filled by the game, the slot and marker table, and the two gates in opposite directions
